content.short: A student-led club at Miami University focused on blockchain education and innovation.
content.description: Miami University Blockchain Club educates students and community members about blockchain technology and its potential to address real-world Web2 challenges. The club provides educational resources and organizes workshops, hackathons, and networking events to deepen understanding of blockchain concepts, applications, and development. By connecting learners with mentors and peers, MUBC aims to inspire innovation and support the creation of new, blockchain-based solutions.
